From a740a423c36932695b01a3e920f697bc55b05fec Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Thomas Gleixner <tglx@linutronix.de>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2020 14:03:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] genirq/debugfs: Add missing sanity checks to interrupt
 injection

Interrupts cannot be injected when the interrupt is not activated and when
a replay is already in progress.

Fixes: 536e2e34bd00 ("genirq/debugfs: Triggering of interrupts from userspace")
Signed-off-by: Thomas Gleixner <tglx@linutronix.de>
Acked-by: Marc Zyngier <maz@kernel.org>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20200306130623.500019114@linutronix.de

diff --git a/kernel/irq/debugfs.c b/kernel/irq/debugfs.c
index a949bd39e343..d44c8fd17609 100644
--- a/kernel/irq/debugfs.c
+++ b/kernel/irq/debugfs.c
@@ -206,8 +206,15 @@ static ssize_t irq_debug_write(struct file *file, const char __user *user_buf,
 		chip_bus_lock(desc);
 		raw_spin_lock_irqsave(&desc->lock, flags);
 
-		if (irq_settings_is_level(desc) || desc->istate & IRQS_NMI) {
-			/* Can't do level nor NMIs, sorry */
+		/*
+		 * Don't allow injection when the interrupt is:
+		 *  - Level or NMI type
+		 *  - not activated
+		 *  - replaying already
+		 */
+		if (irq_settings_is_level(desc) ||
+		    !irqd_is_activated(&desc->irq_data) ||
+		    (desc->istate & (IRQS_NMI | IRQS_REPLAY))) {
 			err = -EINVAL;
 		} else {
 			desc->istate |= IRQS_PENDING;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `kernel/irq/debugfs.c`**
- Added sanity checks in the `irq_debug_write` function to prevent interrupt injection under certain conditions.
- The new checks ensure that interrupts cannot be injected if:
  - The interrupt is of level or NMI type.
  - The interrupt is not activated.
  - A replay of the interrupt is already in progress.
- If any of these conditions are met, the function sets an error code (`-EINVAL`) and prevents further processing.

### Relationships
The modifications in `kernel/irq/debugfs.c` are directly related to the bug fix identified by the commit hash `536e2e34bd00`, which introduced the ability to trigger interrupts from userspace. The added sanity checks enhance the robustness of this feature by ensuring that interrupts are only injected when it is safe to do so, thereby preventing potential issues that could arise from improper interrupt handling.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (irq_settings_is_level(desc) || desc->istate & IRQS_NMI) {
```
```c
desc->istate & IRQS_REPLAY
```
Reason:
The original code only checks if the interrupt is of level or NMI type before allowing injection, without verifying if the interrupt is activated or if a replay is already in progress. This oversight can lead to invalid interrupt states, potentially causing system instability.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (irq_settings_is_level(desc) ||
    !irqd_is_activated(&desc->irq_data) ||
    (desc->istate & (IRQS_NMI | IRQS_REPLAY))) {
```
Reason:
The updated code adds necessary sanity checks to ensure that interrupt injection is only allowed when the interrupt is activated and not already in a replay state, in addition to checking for level or NMI types. This prevents invalid interrupt states and enhances system stability.
